pr_title: Removes request for restarting the editor after resizing the main font
pr_comments: I don't think we should do this, and I second Akien's argument in the original issue. We don't have consistent respect for the theme changes in the editor. It *should* be updated on fly, but in practice a lot of contributors over the years didn't handle this situation properly and it's unreliable to assure the user that the you won't have any issues if you change theming settings without a restart.
I think it makes sense to remove this warning, but only after the caveats have been documented by merging https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/48548.

>  in practice a lot of contributors over the years didn't handle this situation properly and it's unreliable to assure the user that the you won't have any issues

If such cases still exist, they will be spotted rather quickly and get fixed. It's not a big problem; depends on whether we want the editor to reliably reload the theme or not. Lots of work was done towards this and it will go to waste if we just assume that the editor might still break in *some* places.

> If such cases still exist, they will be spotted rather quickly and get fixed.

Well, after fixing a lot of theming propagation in the editor I have to say, it doesn't get spotted quickly, even when problems should be obvious to the user. But yes, intentionally allowing the editor to bug out for the sake of highlighting problems would work, at the cost of user experience.

i would say we need this button on the inspector setting page aswell :P the editor need to be reloaded when changing for example this property

issue_context.title: Main font size editor setting incorrectly requires restart
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

f09d884

### System information

W10

### Issue description

When you change "Main Font Size" in Editor Settings, you get that yellow text saying changes won't be applied until restart. But this is a lie.
![btCwwoGoiI](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/146098257-0cc75a4b-43ac-4cc9-ab9a-3fcefac10932.gif)
This might be not the only setting with this problem.

### Steps to reproduce

See GIF.

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: Well it's not a lie, the font size change is applied, but that doesn't mean that the whole UI gets recalculated to fit it properly IIRC. Some some font-related UI metrics might still need a restart I think.

For example this used to happen: #27663. You can see that many of the Controls didn't update their min sizes to fit the big text.
But indeed this seems fixed in 4.0, so maybe the restart is no longer needed.
The save and restart seems to be needed by the language selector, on the same settings page (4.0)

> The save and restart seems to be needed by the language selector, on the same settings page

Is it? It look fine to me.
![6dJitDhj7O](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/147417548-425f6f83-0210-4451-aeae-5700c3de2e68.gif)

Yeah but the language wont change unless you restart it ?

> > The save and restart seems to be needed by the language selector, on the same settings page
> 
> Is it? It look fine to me. ![6dJitDhj7O](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/147417548-425f6f83-0210-4451-aeae-5700c3de2e68.gif)

> Yeah but the language wont change unless you restart it ?

Indeed, run-time language changes *in the editor* are not supported yet. (They are supported in projects though.)

> Yeah but the language wont change unless you restart it ?

The issue is about font size though, so it's unrelated.

review_comments: You can also remove `PROPERTY_USAGE_DEFAULT` since that's the default.
